translated_title: Return of 500 Species of Fauna and Flora to Lake Texcoco Shows the Importance of Not Having Built the NAICM: Sheinbaum
original_title: Retorno de 500 especies de fauna y flora al Lago de Texcoco, muestra importancia de no haber construido NAICM: Sheinbaum
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Alonso Urrutia
meta_description: The former lakebed is a natural flood-regulating reservoir, and building there would have required permanently draining water at enormous cost, Sheinbaum said.
